summarizer.comment: High-volume per-item summarization. Cheapest Gemma 4; MoE with 4B active params. ~$0.07/M input.

writer.comment: Writes the newspaper copy: headlines, decks, briefs, classifieds gags. Tested 2026-08-07, nails the 1920s broadsheet voice.

editor.comment: Ranks/selects the day's stories and does final edit pass. reasoning_effort caps GLM's thinking so it doesn't spend the whole token budget before answering. Swap to z-ai/glm-5.2 if selection quality disappoints.

fallback.comment: Free tier of the writer. Shared upstream pool, often 429s — use as opportunistic fallback only, never the primary.
